blocks.text: Setting up ChatGPT for online tutors on Mac

The official ChatGPT desktop app for macOS provides a unified interface for chat, work, and coding. Ensure you are running macOS 14 or newer to get the best performance. Download it only from the official site at chatgpt.com/download to avoid security risks. Once installed, press Option + Space to trigger the global chat bar from any application. This is essential when you are in the middle of a Zoom call or reviewing a student document in GoodNotes.

Most tutors spend too much time on the hidden load of teaching. This includes lesson prep, grading, and email. You can save time by creating templates in ChatGPT for common communications. Use the app to draft emails to parents or progress reports for students. When you need to refer back to past interactions, use the search feature in the sidebar. If you find the app lagging, clear your cache or start a new chat session to reset the context.

Lazur helps you stay in your flow while using ChatGPT. Hold Option + Command to ask about anything on your screen. If you are struggling to find a button in the ChatGPT interface, ask Lazur to point at it. It will draw a circle around the specific feature. If you want to dictate a long feedback comment, hold the fn key and speak. Lazur will type it out with clean formatting directly into your current app.

blocks.text: You might occasionally see a something went wrong error. This often happens due to VPN interference or temporary server outages. Try disabling your VPN or restarting the app. If you are using the Work with Apps feature, ensure you have granted the necessary macOS Accessibility permissions in System Settings > Privacy & Security > Accessibility. This allows ChatGPT to read the content of other windows, which is vital for providing accurate help based on what you are currently viewing.

faq.question: Does Lazur operate ChatGPT for me?
faq.answer: No. Lazur does not click buttons or edit files. It guides you, points at things on your screen, and dictates text so you can work faster.

faq.question: Is the ChatGPT app free for Mac?
faq.answer: The app is free to download. Usage limits depend on your subscription plan, such as Plus or Pro, which offer different message allowances.

faq.question: How do I see my chat history?
faq.answer: Open the ChatGPT app and look at the sidebar. If you cannot find it, ensure you are using the latest version of the app.
